矩阵各行应具有一致的列数；转置后原来的列成为行。

cards.description: 判断正整数是否为完全数，即其所有真因子之和是否等于该数。
cards.name: isPerfectNumber
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，且 n ≥ 1。

cards.description: 计算正整数 n 的因子个数。
cards.name: divisorCount
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，且 n ≥ 1。

cards.description: 计算两个或多个整数的最小公倍数。
cards.name: lcm
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，且至少包含两个整数。
输入架构不限制整数的正负或是否为零；如需标准的正整数最小公倍数语义，请自行确保输入符合该约定。

cards.description: 计算方阵的迹，即主对角线元素之和。
cards.name: matrix_trace
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix 二维数组，元素为数字。
输入架构不验证矩阵是否为方阵；应提供各行长度相同且与行数相等的矩阵。

cards.description: 计算第 n 个贝尔数，即 n 个元素的集合划分数。
cards.name: bellNumber
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，范围为 0 至 15（含边界）。

cards.description: 计算第 n 个卡塔兰数。
cards.name: catalan
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，范围为 0 至 35（含边界）。

cards.description: 根据上底、下底和高计算梯形面积。

height.description: 高

cards.name: trapezoid_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 top_base、bottom_base 和 height，三者均为大于 0 的数字。

cards.description: 将实部和虚部表示的复数转换为极坐标形式 r∠θ。
cards.name: complex_polar
usage_rules: 必须提供 real 和 imag，二者均为数字。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的范围，即最大值减最小值。
cards.name: range
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素须为数字。
为获得有定义的范围，请确保数组至少包含一个元素；输入架构本身允许空数组。

cards.description: 计算方阵的行列式。
cards.name: matrix_determinant
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix 二维数组，元素为数字。
输入架构不验证矩阵是否为方阵；应提供各行长度相同且与行数相等的矩阵。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的算术平均值。
cards.name: mean
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素须为数字。
为计算有定义的平均值，请确保数组至少包含一个元素；输入架构本身允许空数组。

cards.description: 计算由实部和虚部表示的复数的幅角，单位为弧度。
cards.name: complex_argument
usage_rules: 必须提供 real 和 imag，二者均为数字。

cards.description: 将数值从一种重量单位转换为另一种重量单位。支持 mg、g、kg、t、oz、lb 和 stone。
cards.name: weight_conversion
usage_rules: 提供要转换的数值 value，以及 from_unit 和 to_unit；单位必须使用支持的枚举值。
value 是数值类型；无需预先换算成特定单位。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的标准差，可计算总体标准差或样本标准差。

sample.description: 是否为样本标准差（默认为总体标准差）

cards.name: stdDev
usage_rules: numbers 为数字数组，是必填项。
sample 为可选布尔值；设为 true 计算样本标准差，省略时默认为总体标准差。

cards.description: 根据债券面值、票面利率、市场利率、到期年限和付息频率计算理论价格。
cards.name: bond_price
usage_rules: 必须提供 face_value、coupon_rate、market_rate 和 years_to_maturity。
face_value、market_rate 和 years_to_maturity 必须大于 0；coupon_rate 必须大于或等于 0。利率以小数形式提供。
payments_per_year 为可选正整数，表示每年付息次数；省略时默认为 1。

cards.description: 根据球体半径计算体积和表面积。
cards.name: sphere_calculation
usage_rules: radius 为必填项，且必须大于 0。

cards.description: 根据初始投资额、各期现金流和折现率计算投资项目的净现值（NPV）。
cards.name: net_present_value
usage_rules: 必须提供 initial_investment、cash_flows 和 discount_rate；cash_flows 是数字数组。
initial_investment 和 discount_rate 必须大于 0；discount_rate 以小数形式提供。

cards.description: 将数值从一种面积单位转换为另一种面积单位。支持 mm2、cm2、m2、km2、hectare、acre、in2、ft2 和 yard2。
cards.name: area_conversion
usage_rules: 提供要转换的数值 value，以及 from_unit 和 to_unit；单位必须使用支持的枚举值。
value 是数值类型；无需预先换算成特定单位。

cards.description: 根据长方体的长、宽和高计算体积和表面积。

height.description: 高度

width.description: 宽度

cards.name: cuboid_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 length、width 和 height，三者都必须大于 0。

cards.description: 根据矩形的长和宽计算面积、周长等属性。

width.description: 宽度

cards.name: rectangle_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 length 和 width，二者都必须大于 0。

cards.description: 计算从 x 轴到点 (x, y) 方向的角度，结果以弧度表示。
cards.name: atan2
usage_rules: 必须提供数值类型的 x 和 y 坐标。

cards.description: 使用梯形法则对指定函数进行数值定积分。
cards.name: numerical_integration
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients、lower_bound 和 upper_bound。
function_type 必须是 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic 之一；coefficients 是数字数组。
intervals 为可选正整数，范围为 1 至 10000；省略时默认为 1000。

cards.description: 找出数字数组中的最大值。
cards.name: max
usage_rules: numbers 为必填项，且必须是数字数组。

cards.description: 计算输入值的双曲正切值。
cards.name: tanh
usage_rules: value 为必填数值。

cards.description: 计算两个复数相除。被除数和除数分别由实部与虚部指定。
cards.name: complex_divide
usage_rules: 必须提供 a_real、a_imag、b_real 和 b_imag，且均为数字。
除数不能为零复数，即 b_real 和 b_imag 不能同时为 0。

cards.description: 使用二分法在指定区间内求解所选类型方程的根。
cards.name: bisection_method
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients、left_bound 和 right_bound。function_type 仅支持 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic；coefficients 必须是数字数组。
应使 left_bound 小于 right_bound，并选择区间内函数值异号且包含根的区间，才能应用二分法。
max_iterations（若提供）必须是正整数；未提供时默认 100。tolerance（若提供）必须大于 0；未提供时默认 1e-6。

cards.description: 计算输入值的自然对数（以 e 为底）。
cards.name: ln
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 value，且 value 必须大于 0。

cards.description: 计算 a 减去 b 的结果。
cards.name: subtract
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 a（被减数）和 b（减数）。

cards.description: 计算数字的绝对值。
cards.name: abs
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 a。

cards.description: 使用牛顿法，从给定初始猜测出发求解所选类型方程的根。
cards.name: newton_method
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients 和 initial_guess。function_type 仅支持 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic；coefficients 必须是数字数组，initial_guess 必须是数字。
max_iterations（若提供）必须是正整数；未提供时默认 100。tolerance（若提供）必须大于 0；未提供时默认 1e-6。
选择合理的初始猜测值；牛顿法可能无法收敛，或在迭代过程中遇到无法继续的情况。

cards.description: 计算由实部和虚部指定的复数的模长（绝对值）。
cards.name: complex_magnitude
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 real 和 imag，分别表示复数的实部和虚部。

cards.description: 根据本金、年利率、投资期数和复利频率计算复利投资的未来价值。

annual_rate.description: 年利率（小数形式，如0.05表示5%）

compounding_frequency.description: 每年复利次数（1=年复利，4=季复利，12=月复利）

cards.name: compound_interest
usage_rules: 必须提供 principal、annual_rate 和 periods；principal 与 periods 必须大于 0，annual_rate 必须在 0 到 1 之间（含端点）。
compounding_frequency（若提供）必须是正整数，表示每年的复利次数；未提供时默认为 1。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的方差，可选择样本方差或总体方差。

sample.description: 是否为样本方差（默认为总体方差）

cards.name: variance
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数字数组。
sample 为可选布尔值；为 true 时请求样本方差，为 false 或未提供时请求总体方差。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反余弦，结果以弧度表示。
cards.name: acos
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 value，且 value 应在 -1 到 1 之间（含端点）。

cards.description: 计算 a 除以 b 的结果。
cards.name: divide
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 a（被除数）和 b（除数）。
b 不能为 0。

cards.description: 计算非负整数 n 的阶乘。
cards.name: factorial
usage_rules: 必须提供非负整数 n。

cards.description: 计算两个复数相减的结果。
cards.name: complex_subtract
usage_rules: 必须提供 a_real、a_imag、b_real 和 b_imag，均为数字。
参数 a_real 和 a_imag 分别是第一个复数的实部和虚部；b_real 和 b_imag 分别是第二个复数的实部和虚部。
计算顺序为第一个复数减去第二个复数。

cards.description: 将弧度值转换为角度。
cards.name: radToDeg
usage_rules: 必须提供 radians，且值为数字。

cards.description: 根据半径计算圆的面积、周长等属性。
cards.name: circle_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 radius，且值必须大于 0。

cards.description: 在支持的长度单位之间转换数值。
cards.name: length_conversion
usage_rules: 必须提供 value、from_unit 和 to_unit；value 必须为数字。
from_unit 和 to_unit 必须分别是 mm、cm、m、km、inch、ft、yard 或 mile 之一。

cards.description: 计算输入值的双曲正弦。
cards.name: sinh
usage_rules: 必须提供 value，且值为数字。

cards.description: Run a process on the Darwin machine, either as a shell command or as an executable with separate arguments. The working directory is required. Optionally provide standard input, a timeout, or request a dry run.

argv.description: Executable and arguments. argv[0] is the executable. Required when mode='executable'. Forbidden when mode='shell'.

command_line.description: Shell command line. Required when mode='shell'. Forbidden when mode='executable'.

cwd.description: Working directory. Required and must be a non-empty string.

dry_run.description: Optional explain what would run, defaults to False.

mode.description: What are you running, two choices: 'shell' or 'executable' (required, no default)

stdin.description: Optional text written to STDIN (written fully, then closed). Useful for heredoc-style input or file contents.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds, must be an integer between 1 and 300000, defaults to 30,000ms

cards.name: run_process
usage_rules: Set the required mode to "shell" or "executable" and provide a non-empty cwd.
For mode "shell", provide a non-empty command_line and do not provide argv.
For mode "executable", provide a non-empty argv array whose first item is the executable, and do not provide command_line.
Optionally set stdin to text that will be written to standard input; it is fully written and then closed.
Optionally set timeout_ms to an integer from 1 to 300000 milliseconds; the default is 30000 milliseconds.
Optionally set dry_run to explain what would run without executing it; it defaults to false.

cards.description: Deletes a single incomplete task by its UUID. Completed tasks cannot be deleted.

taskId.description: 待刪除任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在且未完成的任務ID

cards.name: delete_task
usage_rules: Provide the required taskId as a UUID v4 matching the tool's pattern.
Use only for a task that exists and is not completed.

cards.description: Records and develops a structured thinking process through stages such as information gathering, analysis, synthesis, and planning. It supports revising the expected thought count as the process evolves.

assumptions_challenged.description: 挑戰的假設，是一個陣列字串

axioms_used.description: 使用的公理，是一個陣列字串

stage.description: Thinking stage. Available stages include: Problem Definition, Information Gathering, Research, Analysis, Synthesis, Conclusion, Critical Questioning, and Planning.

tags.description: 思維標籤，是一個陣列字串

total_thoughts.description: 預計總思維數量，如果需要更多的思考可以隨時變更

cards.name: process_thought
usage_rules: Provide thought, a positive thought_number, a positive total_thoughts, next_thought_needed, and a non-empty stage.
Set next_thought_needed to false when the thinking process is sufficient; otherwise continue and adjust total_thoughts if needed.
Optional fields are assumptions_challenged, axioms_used, and tags; each must be an array of strings.
For research or analysis requiring factual information, prioritize relevant project code; if it is unavailable, use web research rather than speculate.

cards.description: Retrieves detailed information for a task ID, including untruncated implementation guidance and verification criteria.
cards.name: get_task_detail
usage_rules: Provide the required taskId as a non-empty string.
Use this tool when you need the full task guidance or verification criteria, such as before verifying a task.

cards.description: Supports focused, in-depth research on programming topics by tracking the topic, current research state, and next steps across iterations.

currentState.description: 當前 Agent 主要該執行的內容，例如使用網路工具搜尋某些關鍵字或分析特定程式碼，研究完畢後請呼叫 research_mode 來記錄狀態並與之前的`previousState`整合，這將幫助你更好的保存與執行研究內容

nextSteps.description: 後續的計劃、步驟或研究方向，用來約束 Agent 不偏離主題或走錯方向，如果研究過程中發現需要調整研究方向，請更新此欄位

previousState.description: 之前的研究狀態和內容摘要，第一次執行時為空，後續會包含之前詳細且關鍵的研究成果，這將幫助後續的研究

topic.description: 要研究的程式編程主題內容，應該明確且具體

cards.name: research_mode
usage_rules: Provide a specific topic of at least five characters, currentState, and nextSteps.
previousState is optional; omit it on the first call or supply the prior research summary on later calls.
Use currentState to identify the research being performed and nextSteps to keep the investigation focused; update them as the research direction changes.

cards.description: Updates supported task fields: name, description, notes, dependencies, related files, implementation guide, and verification criteria. The tool description restricts updates to completed tasks to summary and related files; the provided input schema does not include a summary field.

dependencies.description: 任務的新依賴關係（選填）

description.description: 任務的新描述內容（選填）

implementationGuide.description: 任務的新實現指南（選填）

notes.description: 任務的新補充說明（選填）

relatedFiles.description: 與任務相關的文件列表，用於記錄與任務相關的代碼文件、參考資料、要建立的檔案等（選填）

lineEnd.description: 相關代碼區塊的結束行（選填）

lineStart.description: 相關代碼區塊的起始行（選填）

path.description: 文件路徑，可以是相對於項目根目錄的路徑或絕對路徑

type.description: 文件與任務的關係類型 (TO_MODIFY, REFERENCE, CREATE, DEPENDENCY, OTHER)

taskId.description: 待更新任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在且未完成的任務ID

verificationCriteria.description: 任務的新驗證標準（選填）

cards.name: update_task
usage_rules: Provide the required taskId as a UUID v4 matching the tool's pattern; all other fields are optional.
Supply only fields that should be updated. relatedFiles entries require path and type; type must be TO_MODIFY, REFERENCE, CREATE, DEPENDENCY, or OTHER.
For completed tasks, observe the stated restriction to summary and related files; this schema exposes relatedFiles but has no summary parameter.
Do not assume omitted fields will be changed.

cards.description: Retrieves task-specific implementation instructions and guidance. Calling this tool does not itself perform or complete the programming task.

taskId.description: 待執行任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在的有效任務ID

cards.name: execute_task
usage_rules: Provide the required taskId as a UUID v4 matching the tool's pattern.
Follow the returned step-by-step guidance to carry out the task; do not treat calling this tool as completion.

cards.description: Analyzes task requirements and examines the codebase to assess feasibility and risks, iteratively refining the analysis when prior results are supplied.

initialConcept.description: 最少50個字符的初步解答構想，包含技術方案、架構設計和實施策略，如果需要提供程式碼請使用 pseudocode 格式且僅提供高級邏輯流程和關鍵步驟避免完整代碼

previousAnalysis.description: 前次迭代的分析結果，用於持續改進方案（僅在重新分析時需提供）

summary.description: 結構化的任務摘要，包含任務目標、範圍與關鍵技術挑戰，最少10個字符

cards.name: analyze_task
usage_rules: Provide a summary of at least 10 characters and an initialConcept of at least 50 characters.
Keep any code proposal to pseudocode showing high-level logic and key steps; do not provide complete code.
Use previousAnalysis when continuing or revising an earlier analysis; it is optional for an initial analysis.

cards.description: Lists tasks with their status, priorities, and dependency information, filtered by the requested status.

status.description: 要列出的任務狀態，可選擇 'all' 列出所有任務，或指定具體狀態

cards.name: list_tasks
usage_rules: Provide the required status: all, pending, in_progress, or completed.

cards.description: Clears incomplete tasks and resets the task list. The operation is described as irreversible and does not target completed tasks.

confirm.description: 確認刪除所有未完成的任務（此操作不可逆）

cards.name: clear_all_tasks
usage_rules: Provide the required confirm boolean.
Treat this as a destructive, irreversible operation; invoke it only when clearing incomplete tasks is intended.

cards.description: Searches tasks by keywords or task ID and returns abbreviated task information, with pagination.

isId.description: 指定是否為ID查詢模式，默認為否（關鍵字模式）

pageSize.description: 每頁顯示的任務數量，默認為5筆，最大20筆

query.description: 搜尋查詢文字，可以是任務ID或多個關鍵字（空格分隔）

cards.name: query_task
usage_rules: Provide a non-empty query. Set isId to true for ID lookup; otherwise the query is interpreted as keywords. isId defaults to false.
page defaults to 1 and must be a positive integer. pageSize defaults to 5 and must be from 1 to 20.

cards.description: Scores a task against its verification criteria and records a summary of its completion or required corrections. A score of 80 or higher automatically completes the task.

score.description: 針對任務的評分，當評分等於或超過80分時自動完成任務

summary.description: 當分數高於或等於 80分時代表任務完成摘要，簡潔描述實施結果和重要決策，當分數低於 80分時代表缺失或需要修正的部分說明，最少30個字

taskId.description: 待驗證任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在的有效任務ID

cards.name: verify_task
usage_rules: Provide taskId as a UUID v4, score from 0 to 100, and a summary of at least 30 characters.
Review the task's verification criteria before scoring; retrieve them with get_task_detail if they are missing or unknown.
Assess requirements compliance, technical quality, integration compatibility, and performance scalability as described by the tool.
Use the summary for a completion summary when the score is at least 80, or for issues and correction suggestions when it is below 80.

cards.description: Provides step-by-step guidance for planning tasks or complex features, optionally using existing tasks as planning references.

description.description: 完整詳細的任務問題描述，應包含任務目標、背景及預期成果

existingTasksReference.description: 是否參考現有任務作為規劃基礎，用於任務調整和延續性規劃

requirements.description: 任務的特定技術要求、業務約束條件或品質標準（選填）

cards.name: plan_task
usage_rules: Provide a detailed description of at least 10 characters covering the task and its goals.
Optionally include technical requirements and constraints, and set existingTasksReference to true when existing tasks should inform the plan.
Gather factual information using available tools; do not base planning on assumptions, guesses, or imagination.

cards.description: Initialize the project standards document. Use this tool when the user asks to generate, initialize, change, or update project standards.
cards.name: init_project_rules
usage_rules: Call when the user requests project standards initialization or changes.
The tool accepts no arguments.

updateMode.description:
任務更新模式選擇：'append'(保留所有現有任務並添加新任務)、'overwrite'(清除所有未完成任務並完全替換，保留已完成任務)、'selective'(智能更新：根據任務名稱匹配更新現有任務，保留不在列表中的任務，推薦用於任務微調)、'clearAllTasks'(清除所有任務並創建備份)。
預設為'clearAllTasks'模式，只有用戶要求變更或修改計劃內容才使用其他模式

cards.name: split_tasks
usage_rules: Provide both required arguments: updateMode and tasksRaw. updateMode must be one of append, overwrite, selective, or clearAllTasks; tasksRaw must be a string containing the structured task list.

Use clearAllTasks for a new task unrelated to the current list. Use append to retain unfinished tasks and add tasks, overwrite to replace unfinished tasks while retaining completed tasks, or selective to match and update tasks by name while retaining unmatched tasks.
Keep subtasks to roughly 1–2 working days each, within a single technical domain, and avoid more than 10 at once; if necessary, submit prioritized batches of 6–8.
Limit each split to 5,000 characters and keep the task tree to at most three levels.
Make tasks atomic, with clear implementation details and verification criteria. Include dependencies by exact task name and specify input/output and acceptance criteria where relevant.

For interface-design work, define consistent interfaces, types, required/optional items, errors, naming and dependencies, and useful examples. Provide only high-level pseudocode when needed, not complete source code.
Ensure tasksRaw is valid JSON content represented as a string; do not include comments and properly escape special characters.

summary must be at least 10 characters and remain consistent with the analysis phase.
analysis must be at least 100 characters and include the technical details, dependencies, and implementation approach needed for review.
If code is needed, include high-level pseudocode only; do not provide complete code.

cards.description: Search tasks in a source by status, task IDs, and/or case-insensitive text terms. Terms use OR matching and do not support regular expressions or wildcards. Can limit results for large task lists.

ids.description: Optional list of task IDs to search for

limit.description: Maximum number of results (only for really large task lists)

source_id.description:
Source ID from task_setup() response
- Defaults to most recent in the workspace if not provided
- Try to always provide it!
- If you don't have it, ask the user for a file path and call task_setup()

statuses.description: Specific statuses to get. Gets all if omitted

items.description:
You might need to infer it from the context:
- "To Do" for tasks coming up next (e.g. "Do X next")
- "In Progress" for what you'll do now (e.g. "First do X")
- "Reminders" instructions for you (the AI) to be constantly reminded of
- "Notes" to collect non-actionable notes

terms.description: Search terms to filter tasks by text or status (case-insensitive, OR logic, no regex or wildcards)

cards.name: tasks_search
usage_rules: Call tasks_setup first when using task tools in a conversation; provide its returned source_id when available.
If no source_id is available, ask the user for a file path and call tasks_setup.
Omit statuses to search across all statuses; otherwise use one or more allowed statuses.
Use ids to search for specific task IDs and terms to filter by text or status; term matching is case-insensitive with OR logic.
Set limit only when you need to cap results from a large task list.

cards.description: Initialize a task source from a file path, creating the file if it does not exist, and return a source ID for subsequent task operations.

workspace.description: Workspace/project directory path (provided by the IDE or use $PWD)

cards.name: tasks_setup
usage_rules: Call once per conversation when the user asks to use these task tools.
Ask the user to clarify the file path before calling if it was not provided.
Provide source_path; workspace is optional and should be the workspace/project directory, such as the IDE-provided path or $PWD.
Pass the returned source_id to later task tools when possible.

cards.description: Add one or more tasks in a batch, assigning all of them the required status. Tasks can be inserted at a specified 0-based position or appended by default.

index.description:

source_id.description:

status.description:

cards.name: tasks_add
usage_rules: Provide texts and status; each non-empty text becomes a task.

Choose a permitted status based on the user's intent: for example, To Do for upcoming work, In Progress for work being done now, Reminders for ongoing instructions to the AI, or Notes for non-actionable information.
Provide source_id from tasks_setup when available; if unavailable, ask for a file path and call tasks_setup.
Set index to a non-negative 0-based position when placement matters; omit it to append tasks at the end.
Batch multiple tasks in one call when appropriate.

index.description:
0-based index to place the tasks. e.g.:
- 0 for "Do this next"

source_id.description:

status.description:
You might need to infer it from the context:
- "To Do" for tasks coming up next (e.g. "Do X next")
- "In Progress" for what you'll do now (e.g. "First do X")
- "Reminders" instructions for you (the AI) to be constantly reminded of

- Updating tasks to In Progress moves others to To Do, finishing a In Progress task moves the first Done to In Progress

cards.name: tasks_update
usage_rules: Provide the IDs of the existing tasks and the required target status.
Use Deleted when the user wants the tasks removed; otherwise choose an allowed status that reflects their intent.
Provide source_id from tasks_setup when available; if unavailable, ask for a file path and call tasks_setup.
Set index to a non-negative 0-based position when placement matters; omit it to place tasks at the end.
Moving a task to In Progress moves others to To Do; finishing an In Progress task moves the first Done task to In Progress.
Do not call tasks_summary immediately after this operation; the update returns a complete summary.

cards.name: tasks_summary

cards.description: Retrieve weather alerts for a U.S. state.
cards.name: get-alerts
usage_rules: Provide the required state as a two-character state code, such as CA or NY.
Do not include parameters other than state.

cards.description: Get practical weather advice for a location, optionally tailored to an activity and hydration guidance.

activity.description: Optional activity context for tailored weather advice

includeHydration.description: Optional flag to include hydration advice in the response

unit.description: Optional temperature unit, defaults to C

cards.name: get-weather-advice
usage_rules: Provide latitude and longitude; latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude between -180 and 180.
Optionally set activity to outdoor, commute, travel, or exercise.
Optionally set includeHydration to a boolean to include hydration advice.
Optionally choose temperature unit C or F; the default is C.

includeDetails.description: Whether to include detailed lines such as wind information

periods.description: Maximum number of forecast periods to return

Do not include parameters other than latitude, longitude, periods, and includeDetails.

cards.name: decode_plantuml

cards.description: Generates a PlantUML diagram and returns embeddable image URLs when the diagram is valid, or structured syntax error details when it is invalid. Can optionally save the generated diagram locally.

diagram_name.description: Optional. Base filename to use when output_path is omitted or refers to a directory-like path. The selected format extension is applied automatically.

output_path.description: Optional. Path to save diagram locally. Automatically creates all necessary parent directories. Restricted to current working directory by default. Set PLANTUML_ALLOWED_DIRS env var (colon-separated paths, or "*" for unrestricted) to allow additional directories. Only .svg and .png extensions permitted.

plantuml_code.description: PlantUML diagram code. Will be automatically validated for syntax errors before generating the diagram URL.

return_markdown_embed.description: Optional. Whether to include markdown_embed in successful responses. Defaults to true.

validate_syntax.description: Optional. Whether to validate PlantUML syntax before generating the diagram. Defaults to true.

cards.name: generate_plantuml_diagram
usage_rules: Provide PlantUML source code in the required plantuml_code field.
Syntax validation is enabled by default; set validate_syntax to false to disable it.
The output format defaults to SVG; the supported formats are SVG and PNG.
Set return_markdown_embed to false to omit the markdown_embed field from successful responses; it defaults to true.
To save locally, provide output_path. Parent directories are created as needed, and only .svg and .png extensions are permitted.
Output paths are restricted to the current working directory by default. PLANTUML_ALLOWED_DIRS can allow additional directories using colon-separated paths, or "*" for unrestricted access.
Use diagram_name as the base filename when output_path is omitted or refers to a directory-like path; the selected format's extension is applied automatically.

cards.description: Generates a QR code for a URL.

target_timezone.title: Target Timezone

date.description: The date to get the days in month. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

cards.name: days_in_month
usage_rules: Optionally provide date as a string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

cards.name: get_week_year

The date field is not required by the input schema.

cards.description: Returns the relative time from now for the supplied time.

time.description: The time to get the relative time from now. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

cards.name: relative_time
usage_rules: Provide the required time as a string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

cards.description: Returns the timestamp for the supplied time.

time.description: The time to get the timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS

cards.name: get_timestamp
usage_rules: Optionally provide time as a string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS format.

cards.description: Converts a date and time from a source timezone to a target timezone.

sourceTimezone.description: The source timezone. IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

targetTimezone.description: The target timezone. IANA timezone name, e.g. Europe/London

time.description: Date and time in 24-hour format. e.g. 2025-03-23 12:30:00

cards.name: convert_time
usage_rules: Provide all three required fields: time, sourceTimezone, and targetTimezone.
Provide time in 24-hour format, for example 2025-03-23 12:30:00.
Use IANA timezone names for sourceTimezone and targetTimezone, such as Asia/Shanghai and Europe/London.
